'''Caliph Ullu's palace''' was a palace located in the [[Thousand Thousand]], the most powerful [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]]. It belonged to one of the dozen [[caliph]]s that lived in the city.<ref name="GatORW" />
